rules_tuple: (no-tashkeel, character-level, 28-letter-rasm, hamza→alif normalize, ى→ي, ة→ه, mushaf order, leave-one-out via per-verse subtraction)

primary.description: sign(G_i > 0) fraction across all 6122 within-surah adjacent verse pairs

shuffle_null_gate.note: Shuffle null uses non-LOO model for both observed and shuffled (so bias is constant across the distribution comparison). Primary uses LOO. Disclosure: observed_f_plus_nonloo and primary f_plus may differ slightly because of LOO vs non-LOO.

secondary.description: Two-proportion z-test: Quran f₊ vs each baseline corpus f₊ (worst-baseline-wins)

no_fork_protections_honored: sign locked to f₊ > 0.5 before script run
surah-initial gaps excluded (114 gaps, leaving 6122 pairs)
baselines locked to Bukhari-noquran, Jāḥiẓ Ḥayawān, Mutanabbī Dīwān
data_reuse_disclosed: Reuses normalization from H-NEW-25 (clean_consonants), reuses Quran JSON loader. No data shared with H-NEW-20 statistical machinery.
